messages:
maria: heads-up — deploybot has MIG-7834 scheduled into the midday maintenance slot (AZ rolling). It's a tenant_metadata backfill touching ~2M rows. Currently pinned to quiet-slot until 13:00 UTC. Can we request an early unpin so we can canary before peak? :thinking:
jon: what's the main risk if we run earlier? replication lag or locks?
sasha: last time we saw lock contention on the tenant index, caused a spike in tail latency. staging showed some row write p50 ~250ms but p99 was worse.
maria: agreed. plan is: single-shard canary (shard-0) for 5m, watch replica lag + p99 write. abort triggers: replica_lag > 5s for >30s OR p99_write > 500ms OR any constraint-violation error. Rollback plan is to cancel the backfill job and re-pin the migration.
jon: who can actually unpin deploybot? can we do a manual override?
maria: attempting to follow process — need release note + oncall ack. I opened a short release note with rationale: avoid peak impact and test canary. link: https://rwd.example/release-notes/MIG-7834-canary-early-run
deploybot: MIG-7834 is currently pinned by schedule tag `quiet-slot` until 13:00 UTC. To request unpin, include: reason, canary plan, abort triggers, and an oncall ack in the release note. Use `/deploy request-unpin MIG-7834` once the note is updated.
jon: ack from me (oncall) if canary is shard-0 only and we have auto-abort triggers set.
sasha: I'll own monitoring for the canary. I want a quick script to cancel and a contact list for pg-ops.
ops-runner: noted. canary run command (example):
```
/run-backfill MIG-7834 --shard=0 --timeout=300 --monitor replica_lag,p99_write --notify #eng-releases
```
ops-runner: rollback commands (if needed):
```
/backfill-cancel MIG-7834 --force
/deploy pin MIG-7834 --tag=quiet-slot
```
ops-runner: escalation: if replica lag > 10s or constraint errors repeat, page pg-ops and open incident template `db-backfill-abort`.
maria: thanks — I updated the release note with the canary details and pasted the abort triggers and rollback snippet. requesting unpin now `/deploy request-unpin MIG-7834`
deploybot: unpin request received for MIG-7834 by maria. Approval required: oncall ack (jon present) + monitoring owner (sasha). Pending automated checks: no conflicting maintenance windows and no active pinned releases for the same table.
jon: I approve — go ahead with shard-0 canary at 11:20 UTC. If monitors fire, cancel immediately and re-pin.
sasha: watching. I'll post a 1-line status update at +2m, +5m.
maria: starting canary at 11:20. tagging #postmortems in case we need to follow up. :thumbsup:
